scope: Readonly current-source audit of the second extra-effect Snatch/Dismantlement mixed opaque-hand/public-equipment/judgment selector. No build, fixture execution, foreground UI interaction or production write by this reviewer. Parent supplied native Snatch focused evidence; this report does not independently rerun it.

findings.evidence: TryBeginExtraForeignSelection emits ordinal hand slots with PublicCardId/PublicLocation null. Published opaque choices have no Cards ids and only target seat/slot index/opaque text. The new frame stores hand count, not foreign hand ids/faces.

Equipment and judgment slots store exact public card id/location. Dismantlement filters IsForeignEquipmentDiscardPrevented with actual source seat, and selection checks the same policy again. Snatch retains normal public equipment and judgment selection.

ProjectPlayerView includes hand faces only for that hand owner or explicit revealAll diagnostics. PendingDecision is visible only to its PlayerSeat. FreezePlayerView -> CloneDecision -> PromptChoiceProjection.Freeze detaches read-only Cards/Targets/Parameters. ResolutionStack remains trusted diagnostics, not a player-facing view.

SubmitPromptAnswer requires matching actual actor/current PromptId/published ChoiceId. Public branch requires exact slot/publicCardId and target. TryResolveExtraForeignSelection checks active top child, same ActionId/current extra round, current hand count and exact public location, then removes only its owned child and resumes original use.

GetTrickRepresentation requires live original use representation. ApplyTargetCardEffect moves chosen current entity through Processing once into source Hand or DiscardPile and masks foreign hand identity in target-effect facts/logs. MoveFinishedTrickCard protects the original material before the extra round and during remaining sequential targets; FinishCardUse later moves only material still in Processing, preserving current physical-claim exceptions.

limits: No separate actual mixed public-equipment/opaque-hand selector or Dismantlement fixture run by this reviewer.
No foreground desktop UI acceptance, DPI check, multi-target selector run or same-count hand reorder attempt performed.
Malformed serialized frame and custom derived-event mutation paths are not accepted as proven publicly reachable inputs; command/public-view boundaries were reviewed statically.
Source hashes identify the captured snapshot; future concurrent B/root edits require their own final verification.
